NOTE on documents for first issue
Which documents do I need to put in the Kit if I am applying for the permit also for my wife/husband or for a parent?
• Forms 1 and 2: form 2 is filled in only if the family member has their own income
• Photocopy of your passport and residence permit
• Photocopy of your wife's/husband's or parent's passport and residence permit
• Criminal record and pending charges certificate, to be requested from the Public Prosecutor's Office
• Certificate of residence and family status certificate
• Documents about the house (deed of ownership, rental contract or hospitality declaration)
• Housing suitability certificate issued by the Municipality
• Income documents (tax return, CUD, pay slips, employment contract, also of your family member if they contribute to the family income)
• Italian language certificate, level A2

Which documents do I need to put in the Kit if I am applying for the permit also for my minor children?
• Form 1
• Photocopy of your passport and residence permit
• Photocopy of your child's passport and residence permit
• Certificate of residence and family status certificate
• Income documents (tax return, CUD, pay slips, employment contract)
• Housing suitability certificate
• School attendance certificate if the minor must attend school by law
• Italian language certificate, level A2 (if the minor does not already have a middle school or high school diploma)
Remember that every family member over 14 must fill in their own Kit. If your child is under 14, you can include them in your Kit.
